purpose: A machine-executable ontology and phenomenology atlas that distinguishes state space, dynamics, probability law, measurement class, parameter limits, consistency health, and source readiness without using conformance to standard theory as a pre-data rejection rule.

gaussian_equivalence.statement: For a finite-dimensional Gaussian mediator coordinate h~N(m,C), a fixed linear map R, and a fixed Gaussian measurement kernel or POVM with independent noise n~N(b,N), the commuting classical output y=Rh+n has characteristic function exp(i t^T(Rm+b)-t^T(R C R^T+N)t/2). Models with the same m,C,R,b,N are output-equivalent for this measurement class.

the readout is linear in the mediator coordinates
